name: playbook
description: How a project is set up and how work moves through it, for any kind of project: a small standard for laying out and describing projects, tracker docs that tell agents how to read and write tickets in any tracker, and skills to set up or adopt a project, chart open decisions as a map, turn a finished plan into tickets, capture a ticket, tackle one, say where a project stands and what comes next, and think the work through (grill a plan, sharpen terms, research, prototype, untangle).
